sourceCopy.name: FreeCell
sourceCopy.title: FreeCell Solitaire Online Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Play FreeCell online with legal supermoves, hints, undo and replayable deals. Free in your browser, no account or download.
sourceCopy.intro: Move all 52 cards to their suit foundations. Use four free cells as temporary space, build descending alternating-color columns, and plan each supermove around the open cells and columns.
sourceCopy.summary: Play a full FreeCell solitaire game with four free cells, eight tableau columns, suit foundations, rule-based supermoves, undo, hints and optional replay seeds.
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Build each foundation from Ace to King in one suit. On the tableau, build downward in alternating colors. A free cell can hold one card. You may move a valid descending alternating-color run as a supermove only when the available empty cells and helper columns can support it.
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. The game runs in this browser tab. It does not use an account, upload moves or save a game automatically. A replay seed is optional and stays only in this page.

additionalFaqs.question: How many cards can a FreeCell supermove move?
additionalFaqs.answer: The upper limit is (empty free cells + 1) multiplied by 2 to the power of the empty helper columns. The destination column is not counted as a helper when it is empty. The run must also be descending and alternate red and black.

additionalFaqs.question: Can I move a sequence directly in FreeCell?
additionalFaqs.answer: Yes, if the cards already form a descending alternating-color run and its size does not exceed the capacity provided by the empty free cells and helper columns. The game enforces this limit.

additionalFaqs.question: Are FreeCell deals replayable?
additionalFaqs.answer: Yes. Enter the same optional seed and choose a new deal to recreate its layout in this browser. Leave the seed blank for a random shuffle. No seed or game is sent to a server.
